QuestInfo.name: [Erel Light] Stories of Shadows
QuestInfo.1: The door to Light's Repose is still firmly closed. Instead, you were able to find records on the Terminus Star and the forgotten absolute being from the Luminary Index.
QuestInfo.2: You wondered if it was possible that the dark being that threatened Hielo in the distant past wa related to the voice that called out to you...and you weren't sure you wanted to know the answer.
